mathsRawItems.zh: A cinema had 508 viewers in the morning; the afternoon had 65 fewer. How many in the afternoon?
136 students split evenly into 8 groups; how many per group?
Mum exercises 35 minutes a day; total over 8 days?
A bracelet needs 9 beads; with 282 beads, how many bracelets can be made?
Shop had 604 balloons, gave away 532, then made 228 more; how many now?
5 x 416 = ___ x 5 (commutative property, fill missing factor)

englishRawItems.source: TSA2023_3ERW1 Reading & Writing, Parts 1-3 (Part 4 is an open-ended writing task, excluded)
englishRawItems.notePassagesAreOriginalRewrites: The three passages below (Ocean Diner menu, letter to Grandpa, Ling and the Spiders story) are wholly original compositions written for this batch, inspired only by the observed question TYPES in the source (menu detail-lookup, letter comprehension, animal-story comprehension with vocabulary-in-context and pronoun-reference items) -- not reusing the source's menu items, letter content, character names, or story plot/animal (bees -> spiders), per the pipeline's established policy for copyrighted third-party passages (see uk-ks2-english-reading-2025 precedent).
